entries.note_hr: Put Malog Princa u NP Paklenica zatvoren je do daljnjeg zbog dotrajalih elemenata osiguranja i pomagala u prolasku zahtjevnoga planinarskog puta.
entries.note_en: Put Malog Princa in NP Paklenica is closed until further notice due to worn safety elements and aids on this demanding trail.

entries.note_hr: U NP Risnjak od 26. lipnja 2026. zatvara se planinarski ulaz Vilje te planinarska staza Vilje - Risnjak (dio staze 108).
entries.note_en: In NP Risnjak, the Vilje mountain entrance and the Vilje - Risnjak trail (part of trail 108) are closed from 26 June 2026.

entries.note_hr: Lokalno izraženiji pljuskovi praćeni grmljavinom. Vjerojatnost grmljavine > 70%. Budite na oprezu zbog mogućih jačih grmljavinskih nevremena. Posebno pripazite u izloženim područjima kao što su planine, šume i livade odnosno otvoreni tereni.
entries.note_en: Locally intense showers with thunderstorms. Probability of thunderstorms > 70%. Be cautious due to possible severe thunderstorms. Take special care in exposed areas such as mountains, forests, meadows and open terrain.
entries.gear: Rain jacket; avoid exposed ridgeline and high ground between 07:00 and 15:00

entries.note_hr: Lokalno jaka bura s olujnim udarima, osobito podno Velebita, sredinom dana prolazno će oslabjeti. Najjači udari vjetra > 65 km/h. Budite na oprezu zbog krhotina koje lete nošene jakim vjetrom.
entries.note_en: Locally strong bora with storm-force gusts, especially at the foot of Velebit, easing temporarily around midday. Peak gusts > 65 km/h. Be cautious due to debris carried by strong wind.
entries.gear: Windproof layer; extra care on exposed ridges and open terrain

entries.note_hr: Lokalno izraženiji pljuskovi praćeni grmljavinom. Vjerojatnost grmljavine > 50%. Budite na oprezu zbog mogućih jačih grmljavinskih nevremena. Posebno pripazite u izloženim područjima kao što su planine, šume i livade odnosno otvoreni tereni.
entries.note_en: Locally intense showers with thunderstorms. Probability of thunderstorms > 50%. Be cautious due to possible severe thunderstorms. Take special care in exposed areas such as mountains, forests, meadows and open terrain.
entries.gear: Rain jacket; avoid exposed ridgeline and high ground between 07:00 and 15:00

entries.note_hr: Mjestimice pojačana, još u noći i ujutro i vrlo jaka bura na Velebitskom kanalu. Najjači udari vjetra 35-60 čvorova (65-110 km/h).
entries.note_en: Locally strong and overnight/morning very strong bora in the Velebit channel. Peak gusts 35-60 knots (65-110 km/h).
entries.gear: Windproof layer; avoid all exposed western Velebit sections; no sea crossings with small craft

entries.note_hr: Lokalno mogući izraženiji pljuskovi praćeni grmljavinom. Vjerojatnost grmljavine > 40%. Budite na oprezu zbog mogućih jačih grmljavinskih nevremena. Posebno pripazite u izloženim područjima kao što su planine, šume i livade odnosno otvoreni tereni.
entries.note_en: Locally possible intense showers with thunderstorms. Probability of thunderstorms > 40%. Be cautious due to possible severe thunderstorms. Take special care in exposed areas such as mountains, forests, meadows and open terrain.
entries.gear: Rain jacket; avoid exposed ridgeline and high ground between 10:00 and 17:00

entries.note_hr: Planinarski dom Alan od 19. rujna 2025. ponovno pruža mogućnost noćenja. Kuća i dalje nudi usluge prehrane (po dogovoru) kao i ponudu pića, napitaka i opskrbu vodom.
entries.note_en: Planinarski dom Alan has resumed overnight accommodation from 19 September 2025. The hut continues to offer meals (by arrangement) as well as drinks, beverages and water supply.

entries.note_hr: Na oba ulaza NP Sjeverni Velebit (Babić Siča i Alan) plaćanje je moguće isključivo gotovinom. Radno vrijeme: Babić Siča pon-ned 7:00-20:00; Alan pon-ned 8:00-16:00.
entries.note_en: At both entrances to NP Sjeverni Velebit (Babić Siča and Alan), payment is possible in cash only. Opening hours: Babić Siča Mon-Sun 07:00-20:00; Alan Mon-Sun 08:00-16:00.
